entityDescription: History of TUKE The Technical University of Košice was founded in 1952, but its roots must be sought much deeper in the past. As early as 1657 the Universitas Cassoviensis was established in Košice, but technical education in Slovakia was only elevated to higher - education level in 1762, when the Austro-Hungarian monarch Maria Theresa established the Mining Academy in Banská Štiavnica. This provided education and promoted research activity in a group of scientific disciplines ranging from ore mining through to production and processing of metal materials. The origins of higher technical education in Košice reach back to 1937, when the M.R.Štefánik State Technical College was established in the city. Teaching was supposed to start in the academic year 1938/39, but the pre-war events following the Vienna Arbitration caused the college to be moved first to Prešov, then to Martin and finally to Bratislava, where it remained and later formed the basis for the Slovak Technical University in Bratislava. The true birth of the Košice Technical College came on 8th July 1952, when the Czechoslovak Government issued Directive No.30/1952 Statutes setting up three faculties, namely the Faculties of Heavy Engineering, Mining and Metallurgy. These were joined in 1969 by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and in 1978 by the Faculty of Civil Engineering. The important event of the renaming of the College into the Technical University of Košice occurred on 13th February 1991. Taiseko UG is the developer of RoomAR, a modular software solution.
RoomAR is targeting retailers and manufacturers in the furniture and home furnishing industry to bridge the gap between online and offline, increase online sales and get data-based business insights.
RoomAR Core visualizes virtual products in the real world using an augmented reality mobile app. The user experience is enriched by personalized product recommendations. With the help of deep learning, computer vision and machine learning algorithms, the sense of style and the actual living situation of users are considered.
RoomAR Shop connects the RoomAR mobile app to an online shop so that products can be purchased easily and quickly.
RoomAR Analytics uses machine learning techniques to get data-based business insights across target groups, trends and customer journeys.
RoomAR can be used by end customers as well as sales staff at trade fairs or in showrooms.

Innovery offers specialized consulting services for innovative solutions in the field of Information and Communications Technology (ICT), with a particular focus on Cybersecurity.
Since 2024, Innovery has joined forces with Neverhack, a French group specialized in cybersecurity. This merger has allowed the two entities to combine their strengths to offer innovative and enhanced solutions in the technological landscape, promoting excellence and innovation in ICT.
Innovery is committed to creating a safer digital world by offering innovative and ethical cybersecurity solutions. The company supports businesses in protecting their data through consulting, training, cyber risk assessment, and innovative solutions.

entityDescription:
About Us
Ignys helps two key types of business:
1) Start-ups and businesses with early-stage ideas looking to turn their electronics ideas into volume manufacturable products in a reliable, cost effective and commercially viable way, drawing on almost two decades of product development success.
2) Established businesses wanting to review electronics products to reduce costs, delay obsolescence and meet changing standards requirements.

What Does Ignys Do?
Whatever stage of product development, from idea creation to ensuring products are manufacturable, Ignys has the skills, knowledge, network and experience to move you forward, taking your idea through to manufacture and sales. Alternatively, that may be helping you understand that there isn’t a viable product within your idea. Of course, the former is preferable, but the latter should happen as quickly as possible if it is the case.

As an electronics design consultancy, it is our job to help:

By determining whether your idea is viable
Develop the most cost effective electronics design
by advising on the casing, where needed
Identify the best production sources, including component parts
by identifying where cost savings can be made
Replace obsolete components, including design changes where needed
At Ignys, we work with you throughout the life of your electronics products. Product lifecycles can be long, or short. It will be determined by customer demand and by costs. We help with both.
